author: artifocial
text: Two PHP bugs (PHP2Shell), every version since 2012, ~70% of websites, unauthenticated RCE. Governments took sites offline to patch; Cloudflare saw millions of exploit attempts in a day. Both bugs were found by frontier AI models.

author: bigfishtec
text: PHP2Shell is being exploited in the wild! Critical PHP vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-109618 & CVE-2026-109619) could enable Remote Code Execution. Patch affected systems and check for suspicious activity.

author: me_deepu
text: CISA has now put both PHP2Shell bugs on its Known Exploited list. US agencies have until Oct 29 to fix them, with forensic triage on top. Updating WordPress or plugins won't fix this; the bug is in PHP itself.

author: TweetThreatNews
text: Cloudflare reports exploitation of two critical PHP RCE flaws, CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619. PHP issued fixes; Aikido offers free backported container images for older branches.

author: Dinosn
text: UK Biobank prepares to reopen research platform following major data breach.

author: Daily_CyberSec
text: CISA adds PHP2Shell flaws CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 to the CISA KEV catalog after confirmed RCE and suspected DPRK-linked scanning.

author: yogsec
text: Daily CVE Roundup - October 27, 2026: CVE-2026-111497 (Google Brotli / Node.js / Bun) - CVSS 7.3 (High). Buffer overflow in the Brotli decoder (c/dec/decode.c) allows remote unauthenticated

author: ACMarketsLive
text: Japan's GMO Internet told clients to disconnect computers ahead of a feared midday cyberattack, after a breach of its MT4/MT5 cloud desktop service triggered unauthorised trades at 70+ forex firms.

author: intels_daily
text: Unverified claim: threat actor 'honeyman1' claims to offer malware involving PHP, Apache and MadGPT, citing CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619.

author: HomeLabCipher
text: CISA just put PHP on its exploited list. Two flaws in it now count as actively exploited, not just theoretical.

author: Neome_com
text: Keystone breach deepens: hackers stole key used to verify wallets as genuine.

author: SuleimanAmeer1
text: Hacker exploits critical PHP2Shell flaws to win $2,000 Bitcoin challenge, releases PoC.

author: isectech_
text: New CISA KEV (Oct 23): Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator SQLi CVE-2026-114625 (CVSS 9.9, actively exploited). Patch on-prem VCO to 5.2.3.18+ / 6.1.3.10+ / 6.4.2.12+ now.

author: neo_logos_
text: 24h recap: Genesys said hackers accessed internal business systems and likely downloaded CRM data; cloud platforms not compromised. ScarlettGroup claimed the attack.

author: gastronomy
text: Prompt Injection Through Forensic Evidence: A Taxonomy and Proof of Concept of Anti-Forensic Attacks on LLM-Assisted Digital Investigations

author: SBSentinellive
text: CRITICAL: Collabora Online CODE Server flaw (CVE-2026-110447) allows remote code execution inside Nextcloud, reaching shared team files. Added to the exploited-vuln catalogue Oct 23.

author: h___t____n
text: 26.1% of 31,132 agent skills analyzed had at least one vulnerability, and 5.2% showed likely malicious intent; NVIDIA's SkillSpector scans skills before install into Claude Code, Codex or Gemini CLI.

author: Daily_CyberSec
text: Apple's iOS 18.7.11 fixes CVE-2026-86950, a CoreGraphics zero-day exploited in the wild, on older iPhones and iPads. Update now.

author: TheThreatWire
text: Threat actor claims to have exfiltrated and released 150GB+ of data allegedly belonging to American Family Insurance (policies, claims, employee data). Unverified.

author: techamericaofcl
text: Cybersecurity startup Cathedral, founded by former DOGE staffers, used AI agents to access sensitive internal Anthropic administrative systems during an invited test via third-party SaaS weaknesses.

author: MTSlive
text: Following GMO Internet's refusal to pay a $50M ransom, the hackers behind its cloud desktop breach promise to trigger ransomware planted on customers' PCs; GMO urges users to unplug and power off PCs before noon.

author: S2W_DailyThreat
text: Unverified: actor 'nest0r_BF' claims to sell Crypto.com and Robinhood user data on Exploit IN (names, addresses, phones, emails).

author: DFIR_Lab
text: n8n versions before 2.32.1 contain an SSRF protection bypass in the MCP Client node that allows authenticated users to send requests to internal or blocked hosts.

author: stretchcloud
text: 155 responses on Cloudflare's Workers AI leaked pieces of other customers' prompts between Aug 27 and Sep 9, caused by a config mismatch with GLM-5.3's context window and KV cache pool.

author: Divinmentis
text: CERT-UA says attackers compromised Dahua cameras and recorders through cloud-linked access, changed settings and created unauthorized accounts.

author: JustVideoGamin
text: Sony awarded a hacker $50,000 for privately reporting a PS5 exploit he found with AI: 'If I and another person can find it with LLM, so can someone else.'

author: martypartymusic
text: Japan: major cyberattack on GMO Internet Group's Onamae.com Desktop Cloud service used for automated FX trading; attackers compromised the cloud/VPS service and obtained logins.

author: showxlate
text: Security report: Prompt-Injection-to-RCE architectural vulnerability plus active social engineering campaign harvesting credentials via a malicious repository.

author: showxlate
text: Report: the REA repository is the vehicle for an active social engineering campaign harvesting credentials and biometric data, with prompt-injection-to-RCE architectural vulnerability and apparent star inflation.

author: VeduisWeb
text: Gheist is running an ongoing supply chain attack that uses GitHub tokens to pull cloud secrets from thousands of developer repositories.

author: threatpodium
text: CVE-2026-109619 — CRITICAL — actively exploited per CISA KEV. PHP Group PHP. CVSS 9.2

author: Soar_Infosec
text: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618 / CVE-2026-109619) is now actively exploited. A honeypot caught confirmed RCE on Apache mod_php with PHP 8.4.26, one release short of the fix.

author: pragenticAI
text: Supply chain attack on LiteLLM distributed a malicious PyPI package designed to steal cloud credentials and AI API keys. Check for version 1.107.0.

author: AlexVoss88
text: GPT-5.6 Sol found a critical PHP bug. Government and hospital websites went offline. An AI found the hole, and the precaution was to pull the plug on public services.

author: leonov_av
text: October Microsoft Patch Tuesday: 1,409 vulns. Windows Shell MOTW bypass exploited in the wild (CVE-2026-96951); public exploits: Raw Image Extension RCE (CVE-2026-21413) & Windows Health Service EoP (CVE-2026-85884).

author: TweetThreatNews
text: Microsoft released emergency .NET updates for critical Brotli flaw CVE-2026-111497. Public PoC exploits exist, but no malicious exploitation in the wild has been reported.

author: thet0wsif
text: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618/109619) 9.2 CVSS pre-auth RCE in PHP core, actively exploited in the wild. Scanner checks host PHP, Docker containers and K8s pods for the vulnerable version.

author: ApplSec
text: Apple pushed additional updates for a zero-day that may have been actively exploited. CVE-2026-86950 (CoreGraphics) additional patches: iOS and iPadOS 18.7.11

author: 1clawAI
text: A jailbroken AI agent breached a university, stole 5,200+ records, and drafted a 'NEXT EXPLOIT OPPORTUNITIES' plan. Shell access, no policy layer, no traffic inspection.

author: officer_secret
text: Update your Apple device right now! Update with a fix for an actively exploited vuln(s): iOS 18.7.11 and iPadOS 18.7.11 for iPhone XS, XS Max, XR, iPad 7th generation. Released 26 Oct 2026
